title: invocation-synopsis-and-slo-rca-mapper
author: Ava Chen

feat(telemetry): sampled invocation synthesizer and ingestion pipeline

review_comments: Diego Marquez: Concern about cardinality introduced by invocation_summary labels; asked for explicit cardinality bounds and fallback path. Author response: added tokenized shape hashing and capped label cardinality with documented TTL for ephemeral keys.

Priya Nair: Asked for perf numbers for sampler overhead under 100k RPS. Author response: added benchmark numbers to docs (avg 0.8% CPU, <1.2ms p99 added latency with sampling enabled on a 16-vCPU instance).
Ethan Brooks: Requested that alerts not change existing SLO baselines; suggested feature-flag gating. Author response: implemented rollout flag and added migration notes for SRE runbook.
CI Bot: initial lint failure for TS formatting. Author: fixed formatting in second commit. Diego: approved pending one doc clarification. Priya: approved. Ethan: approved and merged.
description: Motivation: Long-running invocations and verbose token-level traces make triage costly for SREs. We need a compact, low-cardinality synopsis per invocation plus a lightweight RCA suggestion layer that correlates invocation fingerprints with SLO signal shifts. This PR implements a sampled Invocation Synopsis pipeline and an SLO Root-Cause Mapper to reduce time-to-blame and surface high-probability causes without exploding telemetry cardinality. Summary of changes: add a new invocation_summary v1 schema, a synthesizer that compacts the invocation shape (prompt length buckets, kv-cache-miss-flag, kernel-wait-buckets, observable tool-calls) into a short fingerprint, a priority sampler that emits summaries for a configurable fraction of invocations, dashboard panels for aggregated synopsis views and sample drilldowns, SLO-RCA alert rules that surface correlated signals (kernel contention, queueing percentiles, prefix-cache-hit-rate) and a rollout feature flag. Implementation notes: invocation_synthesizer runs in the telemetry producer to avoid extra RPC hops; we use a deterministic sharding hash to limit ephemeral label cardinality; the sampler is backpressure-aware so overhead at peak RPS stays bounded. Backwards compatibility: new metric name invocation_summary_total and associated labels are additive only; all existing spans and token metrics remain unchanged. Testing: added unit tests for synthesizer logic, integration tests for sampler ingestion, and end-to-end dashboard smoke tests in CI. Rollout plan: gate by feature-flag, enable low-rate sampling in staging for 48h, then increase sampling and enable SLO-RCA alerts behind a second flag for SRE verification. Checklist: 1) Telemetry schema added and proto-validated. 2) Sampler and synthesizer implemented and unit-tested. 3) Dashboard + alert rules added and smoke-tested. 4) Docs/Runbook updated. 5) Feature flags added for gradual rollout. Performance: initial benchmarks included in docs show <1% CPU overhead at 100k RPS and p99 added latency <1.5ms for the telemetry path when sampling at 1%. CI: first run failed lint in console TS; addressed in follow-up commit; full test-suite passed on second run (unit, integration, dashboard-smoke). Review: Diego raised cardinality concerns and requested TTL/capping which was implemented; Priya requested perf numbers which are now in docs; Ethan requested no change to SLO baselines and a gated rollout. Merge: after approvals, PR was squashed and merged into main on 2026-02-26. Impact and next steps: monitor invocation_summary_total and invocation_synopsis_error_rate for 2 weeks, collect sampling coverage metrics and adjust sampling policy; follow up with an augmentation that ties sampled synthetics to full-span replay when an SLA breach is detected. Related: linked Linear tasks ENG-4821 and ENG-4890 and support ticket SUP-1223.
